data.one_liner: Read lcov.info files and print coverage reports directly to the console
data.what_it_does: Reads standard lcov.info test coverage files and outputs a formatted report to the console. It supports line, branch, and function metrics, filtering options, multiple lcov files, and CSV output generation.
use_when: You want to view test coverage summaries directly in your terminal
You need to export lcov coverage reports into CSV format
You run multi-module projects and need to aggregate coverage reports
avoid_when: You require an HTML-based visual coverage report viewer
You do not use lcov coverage files
strengths: Supports multiple lcov.info files and multi-module project structures
Offers various filtering options such as file exclusion and inclusion
Can export coverage data to CSV files
weaknesses: Limited to console text output and CSV exports rather than rich HTML reports
No graphical web UI out of the box
data.setup_notes: Add test_cov_console as a dev_dependency in pubspec.yaml and run flutter test --coverage before invoking the tool.
